name: agenthud
description: Renders live A2UI interfaces from natural-language prompts and replays AG-UI event streams. A qte77 agent-native demo — ask it to draw a UI and it returns an A2UI component batch.

skills.name: Render A2UI

examples: Make a login card with an email field and a submit button.

skills.name: Validate A2UI batch
skills.description: Structurally validate an A2UI message batch (root present, no dangling refs, acyclic).
